one.de: Realisierte Form: Forschung wird materiell, bildlich, sprachlich, rechnerisch oder organismisch gegenwärtig.
one.en: Realized form: inquiry becomes materially, visually, linguistically, computationally, or organismically present.

one.de: Kontinuität hält ein Ganzes durch Revision, Umzug und Verkörperungswechsel als dasselbe wiederbetretbar.
one.en: Continuity keeps a whole re-enterable as the same whole through revision, movement, and changes of embodiment.

one.de: Fürsorge begrenzt Veränderung so, dass Identität, Quellen, Grenzen und zukünftige Werdensfähigkeit nicht verbraucht werden.
one.en: Care bounds change so identity, sources, boundaries, and future capacity are not consumed by the act.

one.de: Erkundung ist Zukunftssinn: Was durch bisherige Begegnungen neu fragbar, wahrnehmbar oder machbar geworden ist.
one.en: Inquiry is future-sense: what prior encounters have newly made askable, perceptible, or possible.

6E.wx: A realized form can be revised, translated or rematerialized while remaining attributable to the same continuing work or organism.
6E.wz: Making can become consequential without treating participating wholes, sources or relations as disposable material; creation is bounded by care.
6E.wy: What is made becomes an instrument of further questioning: realized form can generate the next research pressure.
6E.xz: Identity can persist through change without freezing exact state because care protects lawful continuity and boundaries rather than static preservation.
6E.xy: The same practice can genuinely learn: new questions alter future capacity while continuity keeps that learning attributable to one whole.
6E.zy: Inquiry can penetrate deeply without becoming capture or indiscriminate rewriting because care governs what relation may change.

4F.wxz: Stewarded realization: existing forms can be responsibly revised and preserved as the same whole, even without pressure to open a new question.
4F.wxy: Developmental experimentation: a continuing practice can make, test and learn through forms, but without care the relation can overrun boundaries or provenance.
4F.wzy: Bounded experimentation: forms can be made and questioned with relational care, but without continuity the results need not accumulate as development of the same practice.
4F.xzy: Responsible contemplation: a continuing, bounded inquiry can learn and orient, but without Form it need not externalize or instantiate anything that can answer back materially.

constitution.1T: Self-Similar Systems is a continuing artistic-scientific practice in which inquiry becomes actual form, form remains re-enterable through change, relation is governed by care, and the consequences of what is made alter what can be asked next.
